subject.title: feat(android): add inline dictation to chat composer

question: Should OpenClaw ship first-class, platform-backed Android inline dictation in the chat composer rather than relying on the system keyboard or existing voice-note and Talk flows?
rationale: This PR adds a new persistent user-facing Android input mode and microphone-owner behavior; implementation quality cannot decide whether that product surface belongs in the app.

options.title: Sponsor built-in dictation
options.body: Approve the Android composer control, contingent on recognizer-enabled proof of transcript insertion and owner/lifecycle isolation before merge.

options.title: Keep existing input paths
options.body: Decline the new built-in mode and retain system keyboard dictation, Voice Note, and Talk as the supported alternatives.

recommendation.title: Sponsor built-in dictation
recommendation.body: Approve the Android composer control, contingent on recognizer-enabled proof of transcript insertion and owner/lifecycle isolation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned on this PR and authored the current branch implementation, making them the best available routing point for a product-sponsorship decision.
